label: prose:authors-note-verification
html:
Every proof in this paper is accompanied by a formal, machine-verified counterpart in Lean 4, except where a large prior result is cited from the literature; the extent of that verification, and the conditional form in which open conjectures are carried, are recorded in the formalisation notes. The Lean library is rendered to HTML, with every declaration and its source, by the Lean documentation pipeline of folio-assistant-sci, and is published with the paper's site under the route lean/. All computations (braid-word reductions, Gröbner–Shirshov normal forms, linear and semidefinite programs, hyperbolic volumes) execute symbolically in the substrate parameter q, or in arbitrary-precision arithmetic, and attach as witnesses to the statements they support.

The source of this paper, the formal proofs, and the Rust and Python implementations reside at https://github.com/litlfred/qou, released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

Large language models assisted the drafting and the formal verification, necessitated by a physical disability preventing sustained typing. Human adjudication remains incomplete.
